episodes.title: Pilot
episodes.summary: One year after his twin brother Jonathan is framed for manslaughter, stage magician Cameron Black offers to help the FBI solve cases based on illusions that he has performed... and are set up by the same person who framed Jonathan.

episodes.title: Forced Perspective
episodes.summary: Cameron goes up against the Russian Syndicate after they set up Noah Hawthorne to kill a man, convincing him that he was participating in a reality game show.

episodes.title: Escapology
episodes.summary: Kay calls in Cameron and his team to find a way out for an art museum docent trapped in a gallery with four paintings rigged to explode.

episodes.title: Divination
episodes.summary: Kay and Cameron investigate the murder of a psychic, which leads them to another fortune teller who works for an arms dealer the FBI are trying to arrest. Meanwhile, in prison Jonathan receives an offer he can't say no to.

episodes.title: Masking
episodes.summary: A street artist uses his murals to distract people while he and his gang steal national monuments... but Cameron figures that there's more to it. Meanwhile, Dina visits Jonathan in prison.

episodes.title: Black Art
episodes.summary: Fashion model Lexi Simone, Cameron's ex, finds herself the target of a mysterious assailant who uses Black Art to first break into her apartment and then kidnap her. Meanwhile, Jonathan comes up with a way to break the cipher.

episodes.title: Sacrifice 99 to Fool One
episodes.summary: When Cameron is kidnapped, Kay reluctantly brings Jonathan out of prison to help them track down his twin brother.

episodes.title: Multiple Outs
episodes.summary: The same story from Cameron's side, as he tries to find a way to get the evidence to exonerate Jonathan from the Sorceress while participating in her jewel heist.

episodes.title: Getting Away Clean
episodes.summary: Cameron is still on the outs with the FBi after the diamond heist, and tries to get back into their good graces by investigating the case of a police officer who witnessed a murder... and all of the evidence disappeared.

episodes.title: The Unseen Hand
episodes.summary: When a conspiracy theorist is murdered, Cameron and Kay learn that he was doing a story on a secret society... with connections to Alistair Black. Meanwhile, a crooked warden tries to frame Jonathan for murder.

episodes.title: Loading Up
episodes.summary: A spy seals an electronics scrambler from a lab, and Cameron soon realizes that the whole thing is a setup for revenge. Meanwhile, Dina steals Mike's key card to get evidence for Jonathan, and Kay links up with her ex.

episodes.title: Code Act
episodes.summary: The Sorceress approaches Jonathan and asks for his help... and reveals that Cameron chose Kay over Jonathan. Meanwhile, Dina considers telling the FBI that she stole Mike's badge.

episodes.title: Transposition
episodes.summary: The team try to rescue the wife of a political leader who is being used as leverage to keep him from running for office. Meanwhile, the Sorceress tells Jonathan where they met, and Jonathan has a decision to make.
